en: Color postcard showing a very crowded outdoor thermal pool with children and adults swimming and playing around a white concrete slide with round holes. The scene is surrounded by tall poplars and willows, suggesting a spa park. The reverse side has Romanian handwriting, Romanian printed postal text, a printed stamp of Poșta Română, and circular postmarks reading BĂILE FELIX.
